description: Accessify Play provides comprehensive NVDA control for Spotify playback on any Connect-enabled device. A Spotify Premium subscription is required for full functionality.
changelog:
- Far fewer "Spotify is limiting requests" errors: Accessify Play now sends much fewer requests to Spotify.
- When Spotify does ask it to wait, it says how long at once instead of going silent.
- Keep Alive Interval is now off by default.
- Optional: sign in with a Spotify Client ID of your own, with a Spotify Developer Dashboard button in settings.
- Track changes are no longer announced again after a connection or rate-limit error.

translations.description: Accessify Play memberikan kontrol NVDA komprehensif untuk pemutaran Spotify di perangkat apa pun yang mendukung Spotify Connect. Langganan Spotify Premium diperlukan untuk fungsionalitas penuh.
translations.changelog:
- Jauh lebih jarang muncul "Spotify sedang membatasi permintaan": Accessify Play kini mengirim jauh lebih sedikit permintaan ke Spotify.
- Saat Spotify meminta menunggu, langsung disebutkan berapa lama, tidak lagi diam.
- Keep Alive Interval kini nonaktif secara bawaan.
- Opsional: masuk dengan Client ID Spotify milik sendiri, dengan tombol Spotify Developer Dashboard di pengaturan.
- Pergantian trek tidak lagi diumumkan ulang setelah gangguan koneksi atau pembatasan permintaan.
